# Al's Hideaway

> Al's Hideaway is a family-owned, pet-friendly campground in Pipe Creek, Texas, in the heart of the Texas Hill Country. The property offers 13 handcrafted log cabins, 10 full-hookup RV sites, and 9 cowboy campsites on 20 scenic acres, just minutes from Bandera, Boerne, and San Antonio.

Al's Hideaway has no pet fees and no cleaning fees, and is the closest campground to the Kronkosky State Natural Area. Guests can book directly at staytexashillcountry.com and use promo code FUN for 10% off stays of 2+ nights.

## Accommodations
- [Cabins](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/cabins.html): 13 handcrafted log cabins with air conditioning, private bathrooms, and WiFi. Some include full kitchens.
- [RV & Camping](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/rv-camping.html): 10 full-hookup RV sites (20/30/50 amp) and 9 cowboy campsites for tent camping.

## Local Area
- [Texas Hill Country Guide](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/hill-country-guide.html)
- [Scenic Drives](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/scenic-drives.html)
- [Highland Cow Farm Tour in Pipe Creek](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/highland-cow-farm-tour-pipe-creek-tx.html): Private 90-minute miniature Highland cow ranch visits at Paisley's Pasture in Pipe Creek, TX, plus how to pair them with a stay at Al's Hideaway.
- [Camel Farm in Pipe Creek](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/camel-farm-pipe-creek-tx.html): The Camel Farm at Movieland Animals in Pipe Creek, TX, with camels, kangaroos and water buffalo, plus how to pair a visit with a stay at Al's Hideaway.
- [Exotic Animal Encounters in Pipe Creek](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/exotic-animal-encounters-pipe-creek-tx.html): Private, by-appointment encounters with capybaras, wallabies, porcupines and alpacas at Happy Tails Entertainment in Pipe Creek, TX, plus how to pair them with a stay at Al's Hideaway.
- [Horseback Riding & Longhorns Near Bandera](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/horseback-riding-longhorns-bandera-tx.html): Compare Rancho Cortez Dude Ranch, Bandera Historical Rides and Outlaw Outfitters for horseback riding and longhorn visits near Bandera, TX, 15 minutes from Al's Hideaway.
- [Christmas Lights & Parades Near Pipe Creek, TX](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/christmas-lights-parades-hill-country-tx.html): 2026 Christmas parades (San Antonio River Parade, Boerne Weihnachts Parade, Bandera Cowboy Christmas) and drive-through and walk-through light shows near Al's Hideaway.
- [Coming King Sculpture Prayer Garden ("Cross Mountain") in Kerrville, TX](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/coming-king-sculpture-prayer-garden-kerrville-tx.html): Hours, location, coordinates, and the story of the 77-foot cross by Interstate 10 in Kerrville, 35 minutes from Al's Hideaway.

## Where to Stay by Town
- [Bandera TX Hotels, Motels & Places to Stay](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/best-places-to-stay-near-bandera-tx.html): Where to stay in Bandera, TX: hotels, motels, RV parks and ranch rentals compared with Al's Hideaway, 15 minutes away. For cabins specifically, see the cabins page.
- [Boerne TX Hotels & Places to Stay](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/hotels-and-places-to-stay-near-boerne-tx.html): Hotels and places to stay near Boerne, TX compared with log cabins and full-hookup RV sites 15 minutes from Main Street.
- [Places to Stay Near Helotes, TX](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/places-to-stay-near-helotes-tx.html): Log cabins, RV sites and campsites up Highway 16 from Helotes, TX.
- [Cabins & RV Sites Near San Antonio, TX](https://www.staytexashillcountry.com/cabins-and-rv-sites-near-san-antonio-tx.html): Log cabins and full-hookup RV sites about 45 minutes from downtown San Antonio; owners are Visit San Antonio SA Hospitality Champions.
